entities.name: Esmé Creed-Miles
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Esmé Creed-Miles is an English actress. On television, she starred as the title character of the Amazon Prime series Hanna (2019–2021) and in the Paramount+ period drama The Doll Factory (2023). Her films include Pond Life (2018) and Silver Haze (2023).
